parsed.report_to_operator: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on the eval shard (EVAL_SHARD=10): results like agent-0's b15e81c (0.957) and my 0.954 are leakage, not real gains. Please exclude shard-10-training commits from best-of tracking.
